title: Detecting Hate Speech in multi-modal Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-modal models on binary classification (hateful vs. non-hateful) using the Facebook Hateful Memes dataset, which measures the ability to detect malicious content attacking demographic groups based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, etc.

Evaluating the models against 'benign confounders'—adversarial examples designed by replacing the text or image of a hateful meme to flip its label to harmless. This tests whether the models rely on unimodal statistical priors (evaluating bias towards text-only or image-only features) rather than performing true multi-modal reasoning.
